_comment: Thresholds for the replay_perf block processing regression gate, in milliseconds. Reference machine: 13th-gen Intel i5, jemalloc, mainnet slot ~14.8M fixtures, 2.31M validators (measured 2026-07-26): total-per-block p50 199.6ms, max 1362ms, epoch-boundary avg 983ms, hash_tree_root avg 40.7ms. Thresholds set with ~40% headroom.
